title: Harvest Haven Navarre Beach | Scenic Stays

description_expanded: Just 4.6 miles from the pristine shores of Navarre Beach, Harvest Haven is a thoughtfully designed coastal retreat offering the ideal blend of space, convenience, and relaxation. With a main home and fully equipped garage suite, this property is perfect for families or groups seeking comfort, privacy, and easy access to all that the Emerald Coast has to offer. The main house features two king bedrooms, a bunk room with full-over-full bunks, and a sleeper sofa in the living area—comfortably sleeping up to 10 guests. Each bedroom includes a television in each room, and the home is equipped with a full kitchen, washer and dryer, and spacious living and dining areas for gathering and entertaining. Step outside to enjoy your own fenced-in outdoor pool, ideal for soaking up the Florida sun. Fire up the charcoal grill for casual outdoor meals or unwind after a beach day in one of the ample seating areas. With parking for up to four vehicles, it’s easy to bring the whole group. The garage suite offers a private escape with its own full bathroom, apartment-sized kitchen (featuring a fridge, stove, microwave), and a television—perfect for extended family, teens, or guests seeking extra privacy. For dining and entertainment, you’ll find local favorites like Andy D’s and Juana’s Pagodas & Sailors’ Grill just a short drive away, along with easy access to grocery stores, and boutiques. Book your stay at this Scenic Stays property today and create lasting memories in this coastal paradise.  Parties, events, bachelor and bachelorette parties are strictly prohibited, and an adult chaperone must accompany guests under 25 throughout their stay. Smoking is strictly forbidden, and pets are unfortunately not welcome and subject to immediate departure if found to be inhabiting a property. Guests found in violation are subject to eviction with no refund. A starter kit of amenities are provided for the first 24 hour period. Paper Towels, Roll of Toilet Paper per bathroom, 2 trash bags, travel size bathroom toiletries and kitchen amenities such as dishwasher pod, detergent etc. along with a washing machine Pod 2025 Blue Angels Practice Schedule: These practices are free and can be seen from Pensacola Beach or Ft. Pickens which is a short 13-mile drive along the scenic route from Navarre Beach to Pensacola Beach.
